aplQuery:
['moltnet']
| where body == "maintenance.database_capacity_snapshot"
| extend scope = tostring(['attributes.capacityScope']), size_bytes = tolong(['attributes.sizeBytes'])
| summarize size_bytes = max(size_bytes) by bin(_time, 1d), scope
description: Warn when any tracked database scope reaches 1 GiB. Inspect the MoltNet Database Capacity dashboard. DBOS workflow history may drain under its 30-day terminal-only policy; transaction_completion is monitored separately and must not be deleted by application retention; signed diary_entries and embeddings are preserved indefinitely; task_messages drain only through task FK cascade.
name: MoltNet database capacity at or above 1 GiB
